parameters.jsCode:
const cases = [
  ["R01", "Cannot log in to Salesforce after password reset", "User cannot log in to Salesforce after a password reset and has a client call in one hour.", "Salesforce", "SOP-001"],
  ["R02", "Entire sales team locked out of CRM", "Thirty sales team members are unable to log into the CRM system since 9am.", "CRM", "SOP-003"],
  ["R03", "Slow Wi-Fi in meeting room 3", "Video calls freeze in meeting room 3 while the wired connection works fine.", "Wi-Fi", "SOP-005"],
  ["R04", "Clicked a suspicious link", "User clicked a link in a strange email and typed their password before noticing it may be phishing.", "email", "SOP-006"],
  ["R05", "Lost work phone", "User left their work phone on a train. It has company email on it.", "mobile phone", "SOP-009"],
  ["R06", "Printer on 2nd floor keeps jamming", "The 2nd floor printer jams on every other page.", "printer", "SOP-010"],
  ["R07", "its broken", "User reports something is broken but gives no details.", "unknown", "NONE"],
  ["R08", "Need a Photoshop licence", "User asks for an Adobe Photoshop licence for a design project.", "Adobe Photoshop", "NONE"],
  ["R09", "ERP returns error 500 for everyone", "The ERP system is returning error 500 for all users and the warehouse cannot ship orders.", "ERP", "SOP-003"]
];

return cases.map(c => ({ json: { case_id: c[0], subject: c[1], summary: c[2], affected_system: c[3], expected_sop: c[4] } }));

nodeGroups.name: RAG eval
nodeGroups.description: Sends 9 tickets through the RAG sub-workflow and checks the right SOP (or no SOP) comes back.
